_focal_note: Per-founder crop positions, and currently empty on purpose. The branded set in docs/founder-images-branded/ ships its own focal.txt per founder, already expressed relative to the crop, and those agree with each other to within a few per cent -- which is the consistency the set exists to provide. The two values that used to live here (light, find-your-mission-corp) were tuned for the portraits those replaced, and re-applying them to a differently cropped image would have put two heads back out of line with the other fifteen. Anything added here still wins, for the case where one founder genuinely needs it.
